opportunities.title: Transfer loaded totes onto a conveyor
opportunities.summary: Lift a prepared tote from a mobile carrier and place it at a commissioned conveyor handoff; keep the surrounding traffic outside the guarded workcell.

reviewLinks.rationale: A customer describes commercial tote-to-conveyor handling with Digit; a later manufacturer release identifies the deployed generation as Digit 4.
limitations: Restricted workcell and exact tote geometry require integration.
Evidence covers the handoff, not transport across the whole warehouse or picking tote contents.

opportunities.title: Return empty totes after picking
opportunities.summary: Explore repetitive pickup and movement of empty inventory containers after the contents have been removed.

reviewLinks.rationale: The customer named empty-tote recycling as the initial Digit research application. This establishes a task to investigate, not routine operation.
limitations: R&D application announcement; completion and current operating status are unconfirmed.
Nesting, denesting, washing and damaged-container handling are not evidenced.

opportunities.title: Deliver prepared assembly kits to the line
opportunities.summary: Trial a humanoid carrying already prepared component kits to an agreed handoff for human assembly.

reviewLinks.rationale: The original Apollo pilot agreement explicitly explores delivering assembly kits and totes of prepared parts.
limitations: Historical pilot evidence; exact later hardware revision and new-buyer availability are unknown.
Kit preparation, part assembly and a proven autonomous shift are not established.

opportunities.title: Check components before assembly handoff
opportunities.summary: Explore preliminary observations while presenting parts for assembly, with human-defined acceptance criteria and final quality responsibility.

reviewLinks.rationale: The pilot agreement proposes component inspection during logistics handling; no validated inspection-performance result was reviewed.
limitations: Proposed application only; sensing and defect coverage require development.
No metrology capability, final quality approval or replacement of qualified inspection is established.
